money.plain_language_backtest: We tested 681 old coins. If you put $25 in EACH one, that is $17,025 total put in. 43 of them went up — those winners made $514.85 total. The other 638 went down or rugged — those lost $14,257.32 total. $514.85 winners minus $14,257.32 losers = -$13,742.47 net. So if you held ALL of them to today, you would be down big, because most were losers and the winners did not cover them. This backtest held to today with NO exits applied — a coin that pumped then crashed counts as a loss here, even though sell-half / trail exits would have banked some of it. So this is a test of the filter, not real profit, and not a prediction. Why we do not just trade all passes: most passes are losers, so we need the buyer gate (at least 12 real buyers), the Helius holder check, and exits, and we only trade $5 at a time.
